typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		Physician_ID as string,
		First_Name as string,
		Middle_Name as string,
		Last_Name as string,
		NPI as string,
		Primary_Taxonomy_Code as string,
		Specialty_Code as string,
		Specialty_Description as string,
		Group_Practice_Code as string,
		Group_Practice_Description as string,
		Network_Code as string,
		Network_Description as string,
		Alternate_Code as string,
		Alternate_Description as string,
		Prescribers_DEA_Number as string,
		Street_Address_1 as string,
		Street_Address_2 as string,
		City as string,
		State as string,
		Zip_Code as string,
		County_Name as string,
		Region as string,
		Region_Description as string,
		PCP_Eligible as string,
		Source_System as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'Select  LTRIM(RTRIM( [Physician_ID] )) AS [Physician_ID] ,LTRIM(RTRIM([First_Name])) AS  [First_Name] ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Middle_Name])) AS [Middle_Name] ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Last_Name] )) AS [Last_Name] ,LTRIM(RTRIM([NPI])) AS [NPI] ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Primary_Taxonomy_Code])) AS [Primary_Taxonomy_Code] ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Specialty_Code] )) AS [Specialty_Code] ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Specialty_Description] )) AS [Specialty_Description] ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Group_Practice_Code])) AS [Group_Practice_Code] ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Group_Practice_Description] )) AS [Group_Practice_Description] ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Network_Code] )) AS [Network_Code]  ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Network_Description])) AS [Network_Description] ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Alternate_Code])) AS [Alternate_Code] ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Alternate_Description] )) AS [Alternate_Description] ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Prescribers_DEA_Number])) AS [Prescribers_DEA_Number] ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Street_Address_1] )) AS [Street_Address_1] ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Street_Address_2] )) AS [Street_Address_2] ,LTRIM(RTRIM([City])) AS [City] ,LTRIM(RTRIM([State] )) AS [State]  ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Zip_Code] )) AS [Zip_Code] ,LTRIM(RTRIM([County_Name] )) AS [County_Name] ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Region])) AS [Region] ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Region_Description])) AS [Region_Description] ,LTRIM(RTRIM([PCP_Eligible])) AS [PCP_Eligible] ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Source_System] )) AS [Source_System]  from [EXTRACT].FL_3M_Physician',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> Physician
Physician derive(Physician_ID = Physician_ID) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount sink(input(
		Middle_Name as string,
		Region_Description as string,
		NPI as string,
		County_Name as string,
		Physician_ID as string,
		Primary_Taxonomy_Code as string,
		First_Name as string,
		Network_Code as string,
		Alternate_Code as string,
		Zip_Code as string,
		Street_Address_2 as string,
		Group_Practice_Code as string,
		Street_Address_1 as string,
		Network_Description as string,
		Alternate_Description as string,
		Source_System as string,
		City as string,
		PCP_Eligible as string,
		Group_Practice_Description as string,
		Last_Name as string,
		State as string,
		Specialty_Description as string,
		Specialty_Code as string,
		Prescribers_DEA_Number as string,
		Region as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Middle_Name,
		Region_Description,
		NPI,
		County_Name,
		Physician_ID,
		Primary_Taxonomy_Code,
		First_Name,
		Network_Code,
		Alternate_Code,
		Zip_Code,
		Street_Address_2,
		Group_Practice_Code,
		Street_Address_1,
		Network_Description,
		Alternate_Description,
		Source_System,
		City,
		PCP_Eligible,
		Group_Practice_Description,
		Last_Name,
		State,
		Specialty_Description,
		Specialty_Code,
		Prescribers_DEA_Number,
		Region)) ~> FlatFileDestination
